security: Every job this repository defines that runs on a pull request, an issue or a comment checks out with persist-credentials: false.
Every agent step runs with isolate-agent.
The agent action is pinned to a release by commit SHA, with the version in a comment, not to a moving ref.
automation: Where the repository has .agents/skills/, agent steps set repo-skills so the agent loads the repository's own skills from the default branch, on the triggers this repository allows: schedule and workflow_dispatch always, and issues, comments and pull requests only from an owner, member or collaborator on a same-repository head.

Each agent step's model is selected by one expression whose tier conditions are mutually exclusive, and each tier falls back to FRO_BOT_MODEL inside its own condition, so an unset tier variable never passes the choice to another tier.
The agent reviews pull requests opened by the fro-bot user, which GitHub cannot request a review for.
A prompt dispatched to the repository's agent is routed to a branch and a pull request, not kept comment-only and not run in a discarded working directory.
Renovate Approve applies only where the repository's Renovate config enables automerge.
developerExperience: The repository has an AGENTS.md that states the rules its agent works under; the agent holds every ask in this brief against it and may decline or counter.

exceptions.reason: Its release-notes prompt dispatch stays comment-only by a documented contract; the dispatch-to-pull-request standard applies to every other dispatched prompt.
